intended_behavior: This method currently fixes orphaned toolUse events missing toolResult events by generating dummy toolResult content. It should be reviewed to ensure existing functionality remains intact.

Add a new method to detect and fix orphaned toolResult events missing their corresponding toolUse events. This method should generate dummy toolUse content blocks, similar to _fix_broken_tool_use and generate_missing_tool_result_content, and be integrated in the session hydration or message listing flow to ensure paired toolUse/toolResult events are always present together, thus preventing cutoff issues and validation exceptions described in the bug.
